topic: What if Nami had paid Arlong the full 100 million and Nezumi never stole it: the debt was never the real exit, and Nami's plea to Luffy was
title: What If Nami Paid Arlong The Full 100 Million?
description:
What if Nami had paid Arlong the full 100 million beli, and no corrupt Marine ever stole it? This One Piece What If follows the Arlong Park Arc from chapter 77 to chapter 95, using Arlong's own words in chapter 81 to argue that seven million beli was never what stood between Nami and freedom. Would Cocoyasi Village have gone free, and would Luffy ever have had a reason to come?

Along the way: Bell-mère's price in chapter 78, Nezumi's role, the villagers' secret, and why one tearful plea in chapter 81 may matter more than any amount of money.
